statusLine.command: bash -c 'input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r ".workspace.current_dir"); cd "$cwd" 2>/dev/null || cd "$HOME"; dir_path=$(pwd); home_dir="$HOME"; if [[ "$dir_path" == "$home_dir" ]]; then display_path="~"; elif [[ "$dir_path" == "$home_dir"/* ]]; then display_path="~/${dir_path#$home_dir/}"; else display_path="$dir_path"; fi; IFS="/" read -ra parts <<< "$display_path"; if [ ${#parts[@]} -gt 3 ] && [[ "$display_path" != "~" ]]; then if [[ "$display_path" == ~* ]]; then display_path="~/.../$(basename "$(dirname "$dir_path")")/$(basename "$dir_path")"; else display_path="/.../$(basename "$(dirname "$dir_path")")/$(basename "$dir_path")"; fi; fi; time_str=$(date +%H:%M); printf "\033[2m󰷏 %s │ 󰦖 %s\033[0m" "$display_path" "$time_str"'
